title: 第4章 训练营

content_zh:
连同林锐在内的十几个年轻人，以劳务输出为名，来到了西西伯利亚的森林。他们公开的身份是矿业勘察的技术人员，但实际上他们是佣兵。西伯利亚以严寒闻名，而晨星军事保安公司的训练营就在这片广袤森林的之中。
时值严冬，零下四五十度的低温几乎让人的思维也冻结了。从下飞机到训练营的这段路，他们一直挤在一辆破旧的卡车上相互取暖。直到赵建飞让他们下车，林锐和其他人才掀开了篷布从卡车的后面下来。
“我们到了。”赵建飞冷冷地道，“前面就是基地了，所有人都下车站好。白熊，清点人数。”
被赵建飞称作白熊的是一个俄罗斯大汉，金发碧眼将近两米的身高，一身的魁梧的肌肉几乎把身上的迷彩服撑得像是紧身衣。他清点了一下人数，点头道没有问题。
“所有人都注意了，把身上的衣服全部脱了。”赵建飞冷冷地下令道。
“什么？”所有人顿时就炸锅了，“为什么？现在这种低温，你想杀人啊。”
“你们有两个选择，要么脱掉所有衣物跟我走，要么留在这里冻死，我没有意见。”赵建飞冷酷地一笑道，“虽然你们在来之前都曾经受过调查。但是小心驶得万年船，我可不想你们之中有人偷偷带着GPS定位仪，或者乱七八糟的手机，把基地的位置给暴露了。放心，光着身子跑上几公里，还不会冻死。你们有五分钟时间，照我说的做，立刻，马上。”
“你自己脱光了试试！”人群之中有个不知死活的年轻人吼了一句。
他的第二句话还没有说完，就被那个俄罗斯大汉“白熊”给单手扼住了脖子。像是抓起了一只小鸡一样提离了地面。这个人的块头也不算小，但是在“白熊”的面前几乎像是一个没有还手之力的孩子，提在空中手舞足蹈却一点办法都没有。
“好了，放开他。”赵建飞微微一笑道，“看来这是一个有勇气的家伙，不过干我们这一行从来不缺乏勇气，而是缺乏头脑。有头脑的人应该知道什么事情该做，什么事情不该做。什么话可以说，什么话不可以说。好了，白熊，你快掐死他了。”
俄罗斯大汉一脸冷漠地把那个人甩在地上。
那个人跪在雪地上，摸着喉咙，大口的喘息着。刚才那一下，白熊差点把他给掐死。林锐看得很真切，这个白熊刚才的那个动作迅捷而且准确，只要他手上的力度再大一点，这个人一定会被他当场捏碎喉咙，而不会发出一点声音。这是纯正的战场格杀技巧，没有太多的花哨，血腥而且直截了当，讲求一击致命。即便是林锐练武多年，也不免感到一丝寒意。
“你们只剩四分钟了。”赵建飞平静地看着手表。
所有人都屈服了，纷纷脱下了衣物，甚至趴在地上的那个人，在狠狠瞪了一眼赵建飞之后也开始脱掉了身上的衣物。林锐自始至终没有说过一句话，别人做什么，他也照着做。
白熊面无表情地用车上的备用汽油浇在这些衣服上，然后一把火烧掉。
“很好。”赵建飞看着这帮在零下四五十度低温之中瑟瑟发抖的年轻人，露出了他标志性的笑容。“跟着我走。顺便友情提示一下，不想残废的，走了一段路之后，用手搓揉一下双脚。我可不想把你们带到基地之后，就有人因为低温冻伤而截肢。”
看着一群光着身子的男人在雪地里奔跑，白熊在后面哈哈大笑。
他们没有办法不跑，在这样的低温之下，他们如果不让自己的身体充分运动起来，随时会被冻僵的。
基地的入口是一个山洞，似乎整个训练基地都是修筑在山腹里的。门口有着严密的安保措施，除了岗哨，林锐甚至发现远处还有几个隐蔽的火力点，其射击的范围足以覆盖整个入口，不留一点死角。这里俨然是一个军事要塞。
赵建飞把这些人带了进去，每个人进入之前都经过了再次检查，以确保没有携带任何电子设备。不过很快他们就都领到了属于各自的衣服，林锐拿在手里看了看，有些微微皱眉。因为这些衣物像是制式的军服，只是根本看不出属于什么国家和兵种的。

content_en:
A dozen young people, including Lin Rui, came to the forests of Western Siberia in the name of labor export. Their public identities are mining survey technicians, but in fact they are mercenaries. Siberia is famous for its severe cold, and the training camp of Morningstar Military Security Company is located in this vast forest.
It's winter, and the low temperature of -40 to 50 degrees below zero almost freezes people's minds. From the time they got off the plane to the training camp, they huddled in a dilapidated truck to keep each other warm. It wasn't until Zhao Jianfei asked them to get out of the truck that Lin Rui and others lifted up the tarp and got out of the back of the truck.
"We're here." Zhao Jianfei said coldly, "The base is ahead. Everyone, please get off the station. White Bear, count the number of people."
The man Zhao Jianfei called White Bear was a big Russian man with blond hair and blue eyes, nearly two meters tall, and his burly muscles almost made the camouflage uniform on his body look like a tights. He counted the number of people and nodded, no problem.
"Attention everyone, take off all your clothes." Zhao Jianfei ordered coldly.
"What?" Everyone was immediately shocked, "Why? At this low temperature, you want to kill someone."
"You have two choices, either take off all your clothes and follow me, or stay here and freeze to death. I have no objection." Zhao Jianfei said with a cold smile, "Although you have all been investigated before coming here. But be careful when sailing. I don't want any of you to secretly bring a GPS locator or a messy mobile phone and expose the location of the base. Don't worry, you won't freeze to death if you run naked for several kilometers. You have five minutes, do as I say, immediately, immediately."
"Try taking off your own clothes!" a young man in the crowd yelled.
Before he could finish his second sentence, the big Russian man "White Bear" strangled his neck with one hand. It was like grabbing a chicken and lifting it off the ground. This person is not small, but in front of the "white bear" he is almost like a child who is unable to fight back. He is dancing and dancing in the air but there is nothing he can do.
"Okay, let him go." Zhao Jianfei said with a slight smile, "It seems that he is a courageous guy, but in our industry, we never lack courage, but lack brains. People with brains should know what should be done and what should not be done. What can be said and what cannot be said. Okay, White Bear, you are going to strangle him to death."
The big Russian man threw the man to the ground with an indifferent expression.
The man was kneeling on the snow, touching his throat and gasping for air. In that moment, Ice Bear almost strangled him to death. Lin Rui saw it very clearly. The white bear's movement just now was swift and accurate. As long as the strength of his hand was stronger, this person's throat would be crushed by him on the spot without making a sound. This is a pure battlefield killing technique, not too fancy, bloody and straightforward, focusing on a fatal blow. Even though Lin Rui has been practicing martial arts for many years, he can't help but feel a chill.
"You only have four minutes left." Zhao Jianfei looked at his watch calmly.
Everyone gave in and took off their clothes one after another. Even the man lying on the ground began to take off his clothes after giving Zhao Jianfei a fierce look. Lin Rui never said a word from beginning to end. He did what others did.
Ice Bear expressionlessly doused the clothes with spare gasoline from the car and then burned them on fire.
"Very good." Zhao Jianfei looked at the group of young people shivering in the low temperature of 40 to 50 degrees below zero and showed his signature smile. "Follow me. By the way, as a friendly reminder, if you don't want to be disabled, after walking for a while, rub your feet with your hands. I don't want anyone to have their limbs amputated due to frostbite after I take you to the base."
looking at oneA group of naked men ran through the snow, with the white bears laughing behind them.
They had no choice but to run. Under such low temperatures, if they did not allow their bodies to fully exercise, they would freeze at any time.
The entrance to the base is a cave, and it seems that the entire training base is built in the heart of the mountain. There are strict security measures at the entrance. In addition to the sentry, Lin Rui even found several hidden fire points in the distance. The shooting range was enough to cover the entire entrance without leaving any blind spots. This is like a military fortress.
Zhao Jianfei brought these people in, and everyone was checked again before entering to ensure that they did not carry any electronic equipment. But soon they all received their own clothes. Lin Rui took them in his hands and looked at them, frowning slightly. Because these clothes look like standard military uniforms, but it is impossible to tell what country and military branch they belong to.
